$description: A minimal, typographic design language. Two colors + one muted accent, Inter 300/400, generous whitespace, square (one 3px radius), no shadows/gradients/overlays. Typography is the design.
$themingModel: Set data-theme="light|dark" on <html>; omit to follow the OS. The intensity ramp is derived via color-mix so it flips automatically.

intensity.$description: Monochrome magnitude (NOT hue): a tint of fg over bg. Encodes more-vs-less. rampStrength scales contrast (soft 0.78 / normal 1 / strong 1.3).

space.$note: 8rem (xl) is the signature section rhythm — never reduce on desktop.

radius.$note: the ONLY radius in the system; everything else is square.

breakpoint.$note: ≤640 phone (bottom bar) · 641–1024 tablet (right panels hidden) · ≥1025 desktop.

motion.$note: near-zero by design — color transitions only; no slide-ins, reveals, bounces, or loops.

exclusions: no second accent color or accent-as-decoration
no color in the intensity/state encoding (magnitude only)
no images, photos, illustrations, hero art
no text-transform: uppercase (lowercase lives in the content)
no gradients, no rgba() overlays, no blur/backdrop-filter
no emoji, icon fonts, or decorative glyphs
no framework UI libraries / utility-class soup
